english_source_note: Uniform Distribution mod 1 and Weyl's Criterion
statement_en: A sequence $x_n$ is uniformly distributed modulo $1$ if and only if for every Riemann integrable function $f$ defined on $[0,1]$, $$\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}f(\{u_n\})\to\int_{0}^{1}f(x)\,dx.$$
key_techniques: approximation of integrable functions by simple or continuous functions
callout_body: 序列$x_n$模1均匀分布，当且仅当对于定义在区间$[0,1]$上的任意黎曼可积函数$f$，成立$$\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}f(\{u_n\})\to\int_{0}^{1}f(x)dx$$
